winner.text: Add an explicit user-by-tab categorical interaction to the current additive five-field pairwise ranker.
winner.rationale: The current model already contains request context, but it is additive and cannot express that different users respond differently to the same tab. Tab 0 and tab 6 have large supported top-five deficits, while request context was the only positively screened feature family.
winner.exact_ablation: Append exactly one train-fitted categorical feature formed by the pair (user_id, tab), with an unknown bucket, while retaining the additive scorer, five existing fields, K=4 uniform same-user negative sampling, pairwise logistic loss, optimizer, regularization, and stopping rule.

expected_effect.GAUC: Increase by 0.0003 to 0.0015 because user-specific tab preferences can correct within-user positive-negative inversions.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Increase by 0.0005 to 0.0020 if user-tab preferences move relevant impressions upward in the weak tab slices.

selection_rationale: c01 is the strongest next scarce experiment: it has the highest expected primary gain (0.0010), highest confidence among the leading candidates (6), low leakage and runtime risk, and is ranked first by the Consultant (utility 0.72). It is a tightly controlled single-feature interaction that extends the only positively screened feature family and directly targets the large, well-supported tab 0 and tab 6 deficits while preserving the current validated pairwise training setup. This offers a more reliable, attributable improvement path than the more optimization-sensitive hard-negative alternative or sparser video-context interactions.
